kind.title: Title
block.label: {kind}: {label}
vref.addHint: Sent only to MiniMax-H3 in Ref2VA. {max} tracks at most.
vref.full: {max} tracks at most: {first}, {second} and {third} are taken.
vref.videoOnly: A reference video track only takes videos.
vref.disabled: {label} disabled: it is sent to no shot
vref.headTip: {track} — click to select, right-click for the track menu
vref.empty: Drop a video from the Media here
vref.mark.ignored: {label} · shot {shot} — {engine} does not take a reference video: this part is not sent to {shot}. The shot is generated without it.
vref.mark.blocked: {label} · shot {shot} — {engine} cannot play the profile of this shot: nothing is sent.
vref.mark.unknown: {label} · shot {shot} — the engine of the shot is not available: nothing is sent.
vref.mark.trimmed: {label} · shot {shot} — the shot already sends {max} videos: {label} is not sent.
vref.mark.short: {label} · shot {shot} — less than {seconds} {side}: nothing is sent.
vref.mark.missing: {label} · shot {shot} — the media can no longer be read: nothing is sent.
vref.takeOnly: A take is dropped on a reference video track (vref).
dissolve.label: Transition
dissolve.shorter: The film is {dur} shorter. Later shots move earlier; sounds, titles and markers stay where they are.
dissolve.capped: Limited to {dur}: at most half of the shorter of the two shots, on the 0.04 s grid.
dissolve.total: All cross-dissolves together: the film is {dur} shorter.
dissolve.overlap: Plays {dur} instead of {asked}: a shot length off the 0.04 s grid moves where the two shots overlap.
dissolve.tooBrief: A cross-dissolve lasts at least 0.08 s: this one plays as a cut.
dissolve.tooShort: These shots are too short for a cross-dissolve: the cut stays a cut.
dissolve.hint: A cross-dissolve blends this shot into the previous one and shortens the film by its length.
dissolve.rounded: Rounded down to {dur}, on the 0.04 s grid of the timeline.
dissolve.chained: This shot starts from the last frame of the previous one: with a cross-dissolve, the same motion shows twice.
dissolve.splitShortens: Cannot split here: a piece would be too short for its {dur} cross-dissolve. Shorten the cross-dissolve, or split further from it.
dissolve.trimLimited: Cross-dissolve limited to {dur}: at most half of the shorter of the two shots, on the 0.04 s grid.
dissolve.trimStopped: Cross-dissolve no longer plays: half of the shorter of the two shots is under 0.08 s.
dissolve.trimLimitedMany: Cross-dissolves limited to {list}: at most half of the shorter of the two shots, on the 0.04 s grid.
dissolve.trimStoppedMany: {count} cross-dissolves no longer play: half of the shorter of the two shots is under 0.08 s.
dissolve.noSplit: Cannot split inside a cross-dissolve: move the playhead out of it, or choose Cut first.
